# Product Context

This repository is for a platform that helps coaches create and deploy lightweight client-facing tools without deep technical work.

## Default Product Assumptions

- Optimize for coaches as the primary operator, with a simple and non-technical experience.
- Favor early MVP use cases such as PDF access, mini-course delivery, Q&A chatbot flows, funnels, and simple client portals.
- Translate coach answers from a questionnaire into a concrete technical blueprint and deployable product setup.
- Prefer decisions that speed up validation with real coaches over premature platform complexity.
- Keep pricing, access control, AI usage, and compliance visible in product and architecture decisions.

## Instruction Set

- Use the domain instruction files in `.github/instructions/` as the source of truth for discovery, architecture, UX, questionnaire logic, backend, frontend, AI, security, billing, analytics, pilot work, and go-to-market tasks.
- When planning or implementing work, preserve the checklists and priorities defined in those instruction files unless a newer product decision overrides them.
